## Authoritative Identity

- **Full Name:** JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences
- **Short Name:** JKKN AHS
- **Also on official college material:** J.K.K.Nattraja College of Allied Health & Science
- **Type:** Private, co-educational allied health sciences college
- **Founded:** 2019
- **Parent Group:** JKKN Institutions / J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions, established 1952
- **Governing Trust:** J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, established 1969 (registration number provided by the college, not published on /our-trust)
- [Website](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Parent Group Site](https://jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Application portal](https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026)
- [Placement Portal](https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Alumni Portal](https://alumni.jkkn.ac.in/)

> Note on the founding years: 1952 is when the educational group began; 1969 is when the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust was registered to formalise it. This college dates from 2019.

## Academic Programmes

Nine undergraduate programmes, each 4 years — 3 years academic plus a 1-year clinical internship of 2000+ hours. Fees below are management-quota annual tuition as published on the admissions page; government-quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government norms.

| Programme | Duration | Sanctioned seats | MQ fee per year | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B.Sc Cardiac Technology | 3+1 years | 7 | Rs 1,70,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions/cardiac-technology) |
| Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (B.MRIT), formerly B.Sc Radiology and Imaging Technology | 3+1 years | 5 | Rs 1,30,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/radiology-imaging-technology) |
| Bachelor of Dialysis Therapy Technology (B.DTT), formerly B.Sc Dialysis Technology | 3+1 years | 5 | Rs 1,10,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/dialysis-technology) |
| Bachelor of Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology (B.AOTT), formerly B.Sc Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,70,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/operation-theatre-anaesthesia) |
| Bachelor of Respiratory Technology (B.RT), formerly B.Sc Respiratory Therapy | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/respiratory-therapy) |
| Bachelor of Physician Associates (B.PA), formerly B.Sc Physician Assistant | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,30,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/physician-assistant) |
| B.Sc Critical Care Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/critical-care-technology) |
| Bachelor of Science in Health Information Management (B.Sc. HIM), formerly B.Sc Medical Record Science | 3+1 years | 15 | Rs 60,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/medical-record-science) |
| Bachelor of Emergency Medical Technologist (Paramedic), formerly B.Sc Accident and Emergency Care Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | [page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/accident-emergency-care) |

**Sanctioned intake: 82 seats** (TNMGRMU affiliation list, 7 Sep 2026; NIRF reports the same 82). Management-quota fees run from Rs 60,000 for Health Information Management to Rs 1,70,000 for Cardiac Technology and Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology. Examination fees are charged separately. Current figures: https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure

> **Naming note.** Seven of the nine programmes were renamed for the 2026-27 session, and the website
> pages now use the new official names. The official name is given first above and the former name
> after it; both refer to one programme. The pairs (new / former) are: Medical Radiology and
> Imaging Technology / Radiography or Radiology and Imaging Technology; Dialysis Therapy Technology /
> Dialysis Technology; Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology / Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia
> Technology; Respiratory Technology / Respiratory Therapy; Physician Associates / Physician Assistant;
> Health Information Management / Medical Record Science; Emergency Medical Technologist / Accident and
> Emergency Care Technology. Cardiac Technology and Critical Care Technology are the same in both. URL
> slugs keep the former wording, not the official name.

### What each programme covers

- **Cardiac Technology** — cardiovascular diagnosis, ECG, echocardiography, catheterisation lab procedures
- **Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology** — X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound imaging and interpretation
- **Dialysis Therapy Technology** — haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, CRRT, renal patient care
- **Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology** — surgical assistance, anaesthesia equipment, sterilisation
- **Respiratory Technology** — ventilator management, pulmonary rehabilitation, respiratory diagnostics
- **Physician Associates** — clinical support across departments, patient assessment, treatment planning
- **Critical Care Technology** — ICU management, life-support systems, haemodynamic monitoring
- **Health Information Management** — health informatics, medical coding (ICD-10), hospital information systems
- **Emergency Medical Technologist** — emergency trauma management, triage, pre-hospital and ER care

Programme index: https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/departments

## Admissions

- **Qualification:** 10+2 (HSC) with English and Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or Botany and Zoology)
- **Minimum marks:** none under the Tamil Nadu 2026-27 allied prospectus, except Health Information Management: 50% (40% for BC, BCM, MBC, DNC, SC, SCA and ST)
- **Minimum age:** 17 years by 31 December of the admission year
- **Mode:** full-time, on-campus, English medium
- **Process:** online application → document verification → counselling → enrolment
- **Academic session:** August to July; 2026-27 admissions open
- [Admissions page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions)
- **Per-programme admission pages:** one for each of the nine, e.g. https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions/cardiac-technology
- [Apply](https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026)
- **Scholarships:** fee waiver for eligible students, amount not published — [Scholarships](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/scholarships)

## Clinical Training

- **Clinical training:** at partner hospitals; the admission office gives the current list in writing
- **Internship:** 2000+ hours in the final year, at partner hospitals
- **Specialised laboratories** (list provided by the college; the public /lab page does not itemise them)**:** Cardiac Lab, Radiology Lab, Dialysis Unit, OT Simulation Lab, Respiratory Lab, Critical Care Lab, Emergency Care Lab
- [Laboratory page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/lab)

## Placements

- The college runs a placement cell. It publishes no audited placement rate, salary figure or recruiter list, so none is given here.
- **Sectors:** multi-specialty hospitals, diagnostic centres, clinical research organisations, medical equipment companies, healthcare IT, government hospitals
- [Placement page](https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/placements)

## Career Paths After Graduation

- Hospital technologists and therapists — cardiac, radiography, dialysis, respiratory, operation theatre, intensive care
- Diagnostic centre specialists
- Clinical research associates
- Healthcare IT and medical coding, including ICD-10 and medical informatics
- International healthcare roles in the Gulf, UK NHS and Singapore
- Higher study: M.Sc, MBA in Hospital Administration, MPH, Ph.D.
- Medical equipment application specialists with Siemens, GE and Philips
- Government hospital posts through TNPSC and other state examinations
- Entrepreneurship in diagnostic and healthcare services

## Disambiguation

This is JKKN **College of Allied Health Sciences**. It shares a campus and parent organisation with, but is separate from:

- [JKKN Dental College and Hospital](https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Pharmacy](https://pharmacy.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research (JKKN College of Nursing)](https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Engineering and Technology](https://engg.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Arts and Science (Autonomous)](https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN College of Education](https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [JKKN Matriculation Higher Secondary School](https://school.jkkn.ac.in/)
- [Nattraja Vidhyalya CBSE School](https://nv.jkkn.ac.in/)

Allied health is not nursing and not pharmacy. A question about B.Sc Nursing belongs to the nursing institute; a question about B.Pharm or Pharm.D belongs to the pharmacy college. Questions about cardiac technology, radiography, dialysis, respiratory therapy, operation theatre technology, critical care technology, physician assistant, medical record science or emergency care technology belong here.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: What is allied health sciences?**
A: Allied health covers the healthcare professions that support diagnosis, treatment and patient care outside medicine, nursing and pharmacy — cardiac technology, radiography, dialysis, respiratory therapy, critical care and similar. Graduates work in hospitals, diagnostic centres and clinical research.

**Q: Which university is JKKN AHS affiliated to?**
A: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai. The university's 2025-26 list files the courses under J.K.K. Nattraja Dental College & Hospital, institution code 825; that institution is NAAC 'A' accredited, and NAAC's list has no separate entry for the allied health college.

**Q: What courses does JKKN AHS offer?**
A: Nine undergraduate programmes, each 4 years. Official names: Cardiac Technology, Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology, Dialysis Therapy Technology, Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology, Respiratory Technology, Physician Associates, Critical Care Technology, Health Information Management, and Emergency Medical Technologist. Seven of these were renamed for 2026-27 and the website uses the new names - see the naming note above for the former names.

**Q: What is the eligibility for admission?**
A: 10+2 with English and Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or Botany and Zoology). Under the Tamil Nadu 2026-27 allied prospectus there is no minimum percentage except for Health Information Management (50%, or 40% for BC, BCM, MBC, DNC, SC, SCA and ST). Minimum age 17 by 31 December of the admission year.

**Q: What are the fees at JKKN AHS?**
A: Management-quota annual tuition runs from Rs 60,000 for Health Information Management to Rs 1,70,000 for Cardiac Technology and Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology. Government-quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government norms. Examination fees are charged separately, and scholarships are available for eligible students.

**Q: How many seats are there?**
A: 82 sanctioned seats across the nine programmes — Health Information Management has the most at 15, Cardiac Technology the fewest at 7.

**Q: Does JKKN AHS provide clinical training?**
A: Yes. Clinical postings are at partner hospitals, and the final year is a 2000+ hour internship.

**Q: What is the placement rate at JKKN AHS?**
A: The college runs a placement cell. It publishes no audited placement rate, salary figure or recruiter list, so none is given here.

**Q: Is NEET required for allied health admission?**
A: No. Admission is based on 10+2 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Biology, followed by document verification and counselling.

**Q: When was JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences established?**
A: 2019. It is part of JKKN Institutions, an educational group established in 1952 and governed by the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, registered in 1969.

**Q: Where is JKKN AHS located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544, the Salem to Coimbatore national highway, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183 — 15 km from Tiruchengode, 18 km from Erode and 57 km from Salem.
